   620	def bind_claims(
   621	    report_text: str,
   622	    explanation_context: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
   623	) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   624	    ctx = explanation_context or {}
   625	    entries = ctx.get("entries") or []
   626	    as_of = ctx.get("as_of")
   627	
   628	    evidence_occurrences: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
   629	    evidence_source: dict[str, str] = {}
   630	    for entry in entries:
   631	        eid = entry.get("evidence_id", "")
   632	        evidence_source[eid] = entry.get("source", "unknown")
   633	        evidence_occurrences[eid] = entry.get("occurrences") or []
   634	
   635	    text = report_text or ""
   636	    claims: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   637	
   638	    # Neutral mentions such as "关注原材料" are not claims.  A directed fact can
   639	    # be supported by the same official fact, while a causal claim additionally
   640	    # requires an official causal occurrence for that exact term.
   641	    for claim_occ in _extract_term_occurrences(text, _CAUSE_KEYWORDS):
   642	        is_causal_claim = claim_occ["relation"] == "causal"
   643	        if not is_causal_claim and claim_occ["direction"] is None:
   644	            continue
   645	        claim_canonical = str(claim_occ["canonical"])
   646	        claim_dir = claim_occ.get("direction")
   647	        claim_negated = bool(claim_occ["negation"])
   648	        claim_targets = set(
   649	            claim_occ.get("relation_targets")
   650	            or ([claim_occ.get("relation_target")] if claim_occ.get("relation_target") else [])
   651	        )
   652	        supporting: list[str] = []
   653	        fragments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   654	        contradictory_evidence = False
   655	        for eid, ev_occs in evidence_occurrences.items():
   656	            for ev_occ in ev_occs:
   657	                ev_canonical = str(ev_occ.get("canonical") or "")
   658	                if _cause_family(ev_canonical) != _cause_family(claim_canonical):
   659	                    continue
   660	                ev_negated = bool(ev_occ.get("negation"))
   661	                if ev_canonical == claim_canonical and ev_negated != claim_negated:
   662	                    contradictory_evidence = True
   663	                    continue
   664	                if ev_negated != claim_negated:
   665	                    # "未上涨" does not contradict "下降"; it merely cannot
   666	                    # prove it.  Negating the exact same directed fact above is
   667	                    # a contradiction and must fail closed.
   668	                    continue
   669	                ev_dir = ev_occ.get("direction")
   670	                if _directions_conflict(ev_dir, claim_dir):
   671	                    if not ev_negated and not claim_negated:
   672	                        contradictory_evidence = True
   673	                    continue
   674	                ev_targets = set(
   675	                    ev_occ.get("relation_targets")
   676	                    or ([ev_occ.get("relation_target")] if ev_occ.get("relation_target") else [])
   677	                )
   678	                if (
   679	                    ev_canonical != claim_canonical
   680	                    or (
   681	                        is_causal_claim
   682	                        and (
   683	                            ev_occ.get("relation") != "causal"
   684	                            or not claim_targets
   685	                            or not claim_targets.issubset(ev_targets)
   686	                        )
   687	                    )
   688	                ):
   689	                    continue
   690	                if eid not in supporting:
   691	                    supporting.append(eid)
   692	                    fragments.append(_audit_fragment(eid, ev_occ))
   693	        if supporting and not contradictory_evidence:
   694	            status = "officially_explained"
   695	        elif entries:
   696	            status = "evidence_conflict"
   697	        else:
   698	            status = "unexplained"
   699	        ctx_text = _extract_context_around_position(
   700	            text, int(claim_occ["position"]), len(str(claim_occ["surface_term"])), margin=60
   701	        )
   702	        claims.append({
   703	            "claim_id": _claim_id_for(
   704	                "CAUSE", f"{claim_occ['surface_term']}@{claim_occ['position']}:{ctx_text}"
   705	            ),
   706	            "metric": claim_occ["canonical"],
   707	            "cause_terms": [claim_occ["surface_term"]],
   708	            "policy_terms": [],
   709	            "evidence_ids": supporting,
   710	            "source_type": evidence_source.get(supporting[0]) if supporting else None,
   711	            "as_of": as_of,
   712	            "status": status,
   713	            "audit_fragment": fragments[0] if fragments else None,
   714	            "audit_fragments": fragments,
   715	        })
   716	
   717	    seen_accounting: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()
   718	    for keyword in _ACCOUNTING_KEYWORDS:
   719	        positions = _find_all_occurrences(text, keyword)
   720	        for pos in positions:
   721	            canonical = _ACCOUNTING_CANONICAL.get(keyword, keyword)
   722	            canonical = _SYNONYM_MAP.get(canonical, canonical)
   723	            if (canonical, pos) in seen_accounting:
   724	                continue
   725	            seen_accounting.add((canonical, pos))
   726	            claim_negated = _is_negated_at(text, keyword, pos) or _is_direction_negated_at(
   727	                text, keyword, pos
   728	            )
   729	            claim_dir = _extract_direction_at(text, keyword, pos)
   730	            supporting: list[str] = []
   731	            fragments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   732	            contradictory_evidence = False
   733	            for eid, ev_occs in evidence_occurrences.items():
   734	                for ev_occ in ev_occs:
   735	                    ev_canonical = ev_occ.get("canonical", "")
   736	                    if ev_canonical != canonical:
   737	                        continue
   738	                    ev_dir = ev_occ.get("direction")
   739	                    if _directions_conflict(ev_dir, claim_dir):
   740	                        if not ev_occ.get("negation", False) and not claim_negated:
   741	                            contradictory_evidence = True
   742	                        continue
   743	                    ev_negated = ev_occ.get("negation", False)
   744	                    if bool(ev_negated) != claim_negated:
   745	                        contradictory_evidence = True
   746	                        continue
   747	                    if eid not in supporting:
   748	                        supporting.append(eid)
   749	                        fragments.append(_audit_fragment(eid, ev_occ))
   750	            if supporting and not contradictory_evidence:
   751	                status = "officially_explained"
   752	            elif entries:
   753	                status = "evidence_conflict"
   754	            else:
   755	                status = "unexplained"
   756	            src = evidence_source.get(supporting[0]) if supporting else None
   757	            ctx_text = _extract_context_around_position(text, pos, len(keyword), margin=60)
   758	            claims.append({
   759	                "claim_id": _claim_id_for("ACCT", f"{canonical}@{pos}:{ctx_text}"),
   760	                "metric": canonical,

   835	def extract_financial_anomaly_inputs(
   836	    facts: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]] | None,
   837	) -> dict[str, float | None]:
   838	    # [FUND-004B] Group facts by (report_date, period_scope, unit) so that
   839	    # gross_margin, debt_ratio and cashflow comparisons only use values from
   840	    # the same report date, same cumulative/single-quarter scope and same unit.
   841	    # Mixing across groups produced fabricated 88%/-500% gross margins.
   842	
   843	    _INCOME_METRICS = {"revenue", "operating_cost", "net_profit"}
   844	    _CASHFLOW_METRICS = {"operating_cashflow", "investing_cashflow", "financing_cashflow"}
   845	    _BALANCE_METRICS = {"total_assets", "total_liabilities"}
   846	
   847	    def _group_key(item: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
   848	        return (
   849	            str(item.get("report_date") or ""),
   850	            str(item.get("period_scope") or ""),
   851	            str(item.get("unit") or "元"),
   852	        )
   853	
   854	    def _value(item: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> float | None:
   855	        if not item:
   856	            return None
   857	        raw = item.get("value")
   858	        return float(raw) if isinstance(raw, (int, float)) else None
   859	
   860	    # Build groups keyed by (report_date, period_scope, unit).
   861	    # For each group, track the latest value per metric (last occurrence wins
   862	    # when the same metric appears multiple times with the same key).
   863	    groups: dict[tuple[str, str, str], dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]]] = {}
   864	    for item in facts or []:
   865	        if item.get("value") is None:
   866	            continue
   867	        metric = str(item.get("metric") or "")
   868	        if not metric:
   869	            continue
   870	        key = _group_key(item)
   871	        groups.setdefault(key, {})[metric] = item
   872	
   873	    # Sort groups by report_date descending (latest first).
   874	    sorted_keys = sorted(groups.keys(), key=lambda k: k[0], reverse=True)
   875	
   876	    def _find_best_group(
   877	        required_metrics: set[str],
   878	    ) -> dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None:
   879	        """Return the latest group that contains ALL required metrics."""
   880	        for key in sorted_keys:
   881	            group = groups[key]
   882	            if all(m in group for m in required_metrics):
   883	                return group
   884	        return None
   885	
   886	    def _find_previous_group(
   887	        required_metrics: set[str],
   888	        current_date: str,
   889	    ) -> dict[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None:
   890	        """Return the latest group before current_date with all required metrics."""
   891	        for key in sorted_keys:
   892	            if key[0] >= current_date:
   893	                continue
   894	            group = groups[key]
   895	            if all(m in group for m in required_metrics):
   896	                return group
   897	        return None
   898	
   899	    # --- Income group: gross_margin from same-date/same-scope revenue + cost ---
   900	    income_group = _find_best_group({"revenue", "operating_cost"})

   105	def _summarize_args(args: tuple, kwargs: dict) -> str:
   106	    """格式化首参数（通常是 symbol）和常见日期/指标键，用于 trace 日志定位。"""
   107	    parts = []
   108	    if args:
   109	        # 约定：所有 provider 方法首参数为 symbol/ticker
   110	        parts.append(f"symbol={args[0]!r}")
   111	        if len(args) >= 2:

   113	        if len(args) >= 3:
   114	            parts.append(f"arg3={args[2]!r}")

   117	            parts.append(f"{k}={v!r}")
   118	    return " ".join(parts)

   141	def _resolve_vendor_chain(method: str, configured_vendor: str) -> list[str]:
   142	    configured = [v.strip() for v in configured_vendor.split(",") if v.strip()]
   143	    fallback = configured.copy()
   144	
   145	    for provider_name in _registry.list_names():
   146	        if provider_name in fallback:
   147	            continue
   148	        provider = _registry.get(provider_name)
   149	        # 占位 provider（如 cn_stub）不自动追加进 fallback chain，
   150	        # 避免污染日志和兜底链；用户显式配置仍可强制使用。
   151	        if getattr(provider, "is_placeholder", False):
   152	            continue
   153	        fallback.append(provider_name)
   154	
   155	    return fallback
